title: Banana, oat and peanut butter smoothie
summary: Breakfast you can drink on the way.
steps: Peel the banana and break it into chunks. For a thicker, colder smoothie, use banana slices you froze earlier.
Put the soya milk, banana, oats and peanut butter in the blender, with a few ice cubes if you like.
Blend on high for about a minute, until the oats are completely smooth. Drink straight away.
